messages:
maria: Heads-up: deploy-bot just queued a hotpatch image 2026.03.21-hotfix-v3 for eu-west1 and eu-central. Surface-level bugfix for tokenizer fallback. Need expedited approvals to push during the current change window (ends in ~90m).

deploy-bot: [automated] release candidate created: image=redwood/inference:2026.03.21-hotfix-v3, pin=sha256:abcd1234, targets=[eu-west1, eu-central], canary=5%. Run `/deploy promote 2026.03.21-hotfix-v3 --canary 5 --regions eu-west1,eu-central` to start.

sanjay: tagging owners: @ops-duty @emma — do we accept canary or full pin now? any risk to embeddings infra?

ops-duty: quick check: this patch only touches tokenizer fallback path and a small KVCACHE guard. Low risk. My vote: canary then escalate at 15m if metrics good.

emma: +1 for canary. set rollback triggers: error-rate >0.5% OR p99 latency +200ms vs baseline OR token-drop observed.

kyler: add one more: if embed-service 429s spike >0.2% absolute, auto-rollback. Also require release note blurb in changelog before full rollout.

maria: noted. I'll paste the release note now.

maria: Release note (short): "hotfix: fix tokenizer fallback causing rare mis-tokenization on long prompts; no schema changes. Affects decoder path only. Reverted to previous kv-cache lock granularity."

ops-duty: OK. ops runbook: canary 5% -> monitor for 15m. If green, escalate to 25% for 10m, then 100% in 30m. Rollback criteria as Emma/Kyler suggested. ops will hold manual pin at each step.

deploy-bot: [automated] canary started for eu-west1:5% at 6809997782. Monitor hooks: /metrics/release/2026.03.21-hotfix-v3 and /traces/release/2026.03.21-hotfix-v3.

maria: executing promote now: `/deploy promote 2026.03.21-hotfix-v3 --canary 5 --regions eu-west1,eu-central` :fire:

sanjay: watching dashboards. ping me if anything odd.

ops-duty: initial 5m check: no errors, latency steady. continue to 15m.

emma: telemetry looks clean; p50/p95 unchanged; p99 +10ms only. no token-drop alerts.

kyler: embeddings 429s flat.

maria: can we pre-approve full pin if 15m green? saves time. ops-duty: can you call it?

ops-duty: will approve staged pin if 15m clean. leaving a manual gate at 15m.

(15m passes)

ops-duty: 15m passed. approving escalate to 25%. ops will hold final pin at 25->100 decision.

deploy-bot: [automated] canary escalation to 25% started at 6809997798.

maria: note for release notes section: add customer-facing blurb to docs team: "Fixed tokenizer fallback causing occasional malformed outputs on very long inputs." I'll open a ticket.

emma: one more safety net: if errors >0.2% for 5 consecutive mins then immediate rollback.

kyler: agreed. ops, ensure circuit-breaker bound is set to 0.5% so we don't accidentally degrade.

ops-duty: confirmed. circuit-breaker and alerting wired.

(25% run, 10m)

ops-duty: 25% looks good, no alerts. pushing unanimous approval for full rollout.

maria: requesting final pin now. `/deploy promote 2026.03.21-hotfix-v3 --pin`

deploy-bot: [automated] full rollout started at 6809997803. If rollback requested, run `/deploy rollback 2026.03.21-hotfix-v3 --to previous` or mention @ops-duty.

emma: +1 final. thanks everyone.

sanjay: noting for Release Notes: link to changelog ticket #RC-1445 and add ops contact.

maria: closing thread once rollout completes. will post final status and release note link. :white_check_mark:
